== Players Committee forum (forum.starwarsccg.org) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
New page from posts on the Players Committee forum. Topics used: 10491.
The cited posts are live forum.starwarsccg.org posts; they have no Internet Archive capture yet (forum snapshots are to be added later), so the refs carry no Preserved copy for now.
=== Identification ===
* The second-place player is posted only as "Raveling" (deadbody, p145773). He is linked to [[Michael Raveling]], the Minnesota player of that name (small-world rule).
* Clone Maul's post (p145865) says he went 5–1 with Alden's decks; _maul's post (p145727) says Sam Tashima went 5–1 and won, so Clone Maul is Sam Tashima here. _maul is [[Alden Peterson]] per his wiki page.
